h1: Araya Boutique Hotel — a boutique stay with a pool in central Thong Sala you can dip into from your door
intro: If you want a place in Thong Sala you can walk to from the pier, night market and restaurants — but still with a pool to cool off in — Araya Boutique Hotel hits that sweet spot · It's a 30-room, 3-star boutique hotel in the island's main town, with an outdoor swimming pool and some rooms that step straight into the water · It's around a 9-minute walk to Thong Sala Beach, close to the night market, pier and 7-Eleven · Rooms are clean with cold AC, free Wi-Fi and free parking, starting from around ฿900/night in normal season — great value for a central in-town location that also comes with a pool.

body.html: Araya Boutique Hotel (still listed on some booking sites under its former name, Phatchara Boutique) is a 30-room, 3-star boutique hotel that opened back in 2011 in Thong Sala, the main town where every Koh Phangan ferry docks · What sets Araya apart from the usual in-town boutique is that it actually has an outdoor swimming pool despite being in the heart of town · Many reviews say the pool is a good size with a pleasant temperature, and some rooms are pool-access — you step straight from your door into the water, which is hard to find at this price in Thong Sala.

There's a good spread of room types, from a Private Double and Deluxe Triple up to a Deluxe Family for four, plus Superior pool-access rooms · Most are simply furnished AC rooms with a flat-screen TV, fridge, free bottled water and toiletries · A lot of reviews praise the rooms as clean, comfortable and great value, with some saying they got a bigger room than expected for the price · Be realistic, though: a few rooms are fairly compact with small bathrooms, and some bathrooms have no window so they can feel damp — for a longer stay, it's worth asking to see the room or picking a larger type.
"Really beautiful, clean room and lovely staff. The location was perfect — close to the centre so everything's an easy walk — and there's even a pool to jump in come evening. Brilliant value."

Location is the other strong point · Araya sits in Thong Sala where almost everything is within walking distance — the night market, walking street, restaurants, supermarkets, ATMs and a 7-Eleven are all on foot · Thong Sala Pier and Raja Ferry Port are close by, handy for ferry connections · It's about a 9-minute walk to Thong Sala Beach, with well-reviewed restaurants like Sirtaki Taverna and Wasabi Phangan nearby · This kind of location suits travellers who want an in-town base to fan out to the other beaches, but still want a pool to come back to in the evening.

A few things to be straight about · First, insects — while many reviews say the rooms are clean with no bugs or mosquitoes, a handful do report ants, mosquitoes or bugs, which points to housekeeping that isn't perfectly consistent room to room · Keep doors and windows shut and pack mosquito repellent · Second, inconsistent service — most reviews praise friendly, helpful staff and the shuttle service, but a few mention a cool welcome · Third, rooms right by the pool can be a little overlooked from outside, so if privacy matters, choose a room away from the pool.

The overall scores reflect a well-located, good-value hotel with a pool — but not a luxury one · Trip.com rates it around 8.2 from 100-plus guests and Booking.com is similar at around 8.2, while Agoda sits around 7.9 from 200-plus reviews · Guests who come expecting a clean room, a central location and a pool at a budget price tend to leave happy; those expecting a beachfront resort or a luxe feel may find it doesn't match the picture — this is an in-town boutique that happens to have a pool, not a beach resort.

In short, Araya Boutique Hotel stands out for combining a central Thong Sala location with a swimming pool, all at a light price · It suits travellers who want to be near town, walk to the pier and night market, but still have a pool to cool off in — good for couples, small families and ferry travellers using Thong Sala as a base · But if you've come to Koh Phangan to wake up to the sea outside your room and a quiet resort vibe, this isn't it — choose a beachfront stay at Srithanu, Haad Yao or Thong Nai Pan instead.

A tip from reading the real reviews: if you want easy pool access, ask for a Superior pool-access room you can step into the water from — but choose a room away from the pool if you'd rather have privacy · Pack mosquito repellent and check the bathroom's ventilation when picking a room · In high season and on full-moon nights, book ahead as rooms fill fast — and don't miss the Thong Sala night market in the evening, just a short walk away.

honestSummary: Araya Boutique Hotel is an in-town boutique for travellers who want a walk-to-the-pier location plus a pool to cool off in, at a budget price — ideal as a central base for couples, small families and ferry travellers · Just accept that some rooms are small, there can be the odd insect, service is inconsistent, and it's not a beachfront resort.
honestChecks: If you came to Koh Phangan to wake up to the sea outside your room — Araya is in town with only a pool, not on the beach → choose a beachfront resort at Srithanu, Haad Yao or Thong Nai Pan instead.

If you're sensitive to insects or want a well-ventilated bathroom — a few rooms get ants/mosquitoes and some bathrooms have no window → bring repellent, keep doors and windows shut, and ask to see the room before checking in.
If privacy matters to you — rooms right by the pool can be overlooked from outside → choose a room away from the pool, or keep the curtains drawn when inside.

tips.title: Rent a scooter for the other beaches
tips.body: Araya is in town with free parking and rental shops nearby — a scooter makes hopping to Haad Yao, Srithanu or Haad Rin far easier.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Araya Boutique Hotel Koh Phangan

faq.q: Where is Araya Boutique Hotel and how do I get there?
faq.a: Araya Boutique Hotel is at 204/30 Moo 1 in Thong Sala, the main town of Koh Phangan · It's about a 9-minute walk to Thong Sala Beach, and close to the night market, walking street, restaurants, 7-Eleven and the pier · Thong Sala Pier and Raja Ferry Port are nearby, making it handy for ferry connections.

faq.q: How much does Araya Boutique Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: In normal season it starts at around ฿900/night for a Private Double · A Deluxe Triple is around ฿1,200, a Superior Pool Access around ฿1,500 and a Deluxe Family for four around ฿1,900 · All rooms are air-conditioned with a TV, fridge, free bottled water and free Wi-Fi · Prices swing with the season and full-moon nights, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Araya Boutique Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes · Araya has an outdoor swimming pool even though it's in the centre of Thong Sala · Some rooms are Superior Pool Access, letting you step straight from your door into the water · Many reviews say the pool is a good size with a pleasant temperature — a standout that's hard to find at this price in town.

faq.q: Who is Araya Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for couples, small families and ferry travellers who want a central location plus a pool at a budget price · You can walk to the pier, night market and restaurants · It's not for those wanting a beachfront resort, the sea outside their room, or a quiet luxe setting.

faq.q: Does Araya Boutique Hotel serve breakfast, and what are the check-in times?
faq.a: There's no breakfast service, but there are restaurants and a night market within walking distance · Check-in is 14:00–21:00 and check-out is before 11:00 · If you'll reach the island late, message the hotel in advance.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: For full-moon nights (once a month) and the Dec–Feb high season, book 3–6 weeks ahead, since there are only 30 rooms and a central location with a pool is in demand · Otherwise 1–2 weeks is fine · Pick a free-cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm yet.
